title: Amasian TV Streams Chiikawa Anime for Free in U.S.
content: ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV announced on Thursday it is now streaming a selection of 20 episodes of the anime adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga with English subtitles and Japanese audio in the United States.

title: Uma Musume Franchise Announces New Umayuru Full Gate! Short Anime
content: The Uma Musume Pretty Derby franchise announced on Saturday a new short anime titled Umayuru Full Gate! , which will stream on the franchise 's official YouTube channel after the broadcast of PakaLive TV in September. Animation studio AtoriE is producing the short anime.
